warnings: A row of 4 shophouse units: x = grids 1-5 at 4.00 (16.00); y = Thai-lettered rows printed top-to-bottom จ, ง, ค, ข, ก. Origin = top-left จ1.

Conflict: the floor-1 plan S-03 prints จ→ง = 4.25, but S-01 and S-02 both print 4.00. The grid follows the two footing plans; S-03's 4.25 is kept in unassigned_dimensions and its y chain is recorded from ง onwards only.
จ'' (≈1.20, bathroom beam B1 in bay จ-ง) is scaled and flagged.
Architectural sheets were not dimension-swept (op04 time budget).

2026-10-23 op04 resume: dimension sweep of S-04 (ชั้นลอย), S-05 (ชั้น 2), S-06 (หลังคา) added. On S-05 the beams are drawn about half a beam width (≈0.10) beyond the printed ticks (the ticks dimension a beam face); beams are placed on the tick lines, the same reading S-03 used.

x lines 4.90/7.10/8.90/11.10/12.90/15.10 and 6.80/9.20/14.80 are typical-bay positions: the plan draws every unit identically but prints the dimension under bay 1-2 only. Added per spec section 4 Span amendment (2026-08-29, measured by proportion) and flagged position_scaled_from_grid_not_printed; risk accepted: if one unit differs, refs there are off by the drawing precision only.

op_fix/gridfix 2026-09-29: dummy primes re-sequenced into reading order (spec section 4 Dummy grid) -- 1' -> 1''', 2' -> 2'', 3' -> 3''', 4' -> 4'', จ'' -> จ'''; grid refs in every file of the house follow; prose in older warnings still uses the old names
